questions.stem: Instead of designing a common workload from scratch, what proven, validated design should an architect start from?
questions.zhStem: 与其从零设计常见工作负载，架构师应该从哪种经过验证的设计入手？
questions.definition: Before inventing an architecture from scratch, review validated reference architectures and fundamentals from the Azure Architecture Center. Explore validated reference architectures for common workloads. These architectures help accelerate design decisions and reduce risk.
questions.zh: 在从零开始发明一种架构之前，请先查看 Azure 体系结构中心提供的经过验证的参考架构和基础知识。探索针对常见工作负载的经过验证的参考架构。这些架构有助于加快设计决策并降低风险。

questions.stem: Which architecture style splits an app into separate UI, business logic and database layers, each on its own VMs?
questions.zhStem: 哪种架构风格把应用拆成界面、业务逻辑和数据库三个独立层，各自运行在自己的虚拟机上？
questions.definition: An N-tier architecture divides an application into logical layers and physical tiers. ... A traditional three-tier application has a presentation tier, an optional middle tier, and a database tier.
questions.zh: N 层架构将应用程序划分为逻辑层和物理层。……传统的三层应用程序具有表示层、可选的中间层和数据库层。

questions.stem: Which Azure container holds an app's related resources so you can manage them together and delete them all at once?
questions.zhStem: 哪种 Azure 容器存放一个应用的相关资源，便于统一管理并一次全部删除？
questions.definition: A resource group is a container that you use to manage related resources for an Azure solution. ... When you delete a resource group, all resources in the resource group are also deleted.
questions.zh: 资源组是一个容器，用于管理 Azure 解决方案的相关资源。……删除资源组时，资源组中的所有资源也会被删除。

questions.stem: In a three-tier app, which tier receives browser requests and shows pages, running on stateless VMs?
questions.zhStem: 在三层应用中，哪一层接收浏览器请求并显示页面，运行在无状态虚拟机上？
questions.definition: The presentation tier is labeled Web tier. ... The web and business tiers are stateless. Any VM can handle any request for that tier.
questions.zh: 表示层标记为 Web 层。……Web 层和业务层是无状态的。任何虚拟机都可以处理该层的任何请求。

questions.stem: In a three-tier app, which tier runs the processing rules between the front end and the database?
questions.zhStem: 在三层应用中，哪一层运行位于前端和数据库之间的处理规则？
questions.definition: The layer labeled Business tier in the reference diagram refers to the business logic tier. ... The web and business tiers are stateless. Any VM can handle any request for that tier.
questions.zh: 参考关系图中标记为业务层的层是指业务逻辑层。……Web 层和业务层是无状态的。任何虚拟机都可以处理该层的任何请求。

questions.stem: In a three-tier app, which tier holds the replicated database and accepts requests only from the middle tier?
questions.zhStem: 在三层应用中，哪一层存放复制的数据库，并且只接受来自中间层的请求？
questions.definition: The data tier should consist of a replicated database. ... Restrict access to the data tier by allowing requests from a middle tier only.
questions.zh: 数据层应由复制的数据库组成。……通过仅允许来自中间层的请求来限制对数据层的访问。

questions.stem: Which Microsoft relational database engine do applications query using T-SQL?
questions.zhStem: 应用程序使用 T-SQL 查询的是哪个 Microsoft 关系型数据库引擎？
questions.definition: Microsoft SQL Server is a relational database management system (RDBMS). Applications and tools connect to a SQL Server instance or database, and communicate using Transact-SQL (T-SQL).
questions.zh: Microsoft SQL Server 是一种关系数据库管理系统（RDBMS）。应用程序和工具连接到 SQL Server 实例或数据库，并使用 Transact-SQL（T-SQL）进行通信。

questions.stem: What Azure resource gives VMs an isolated private network to reach each other, the internet and on-premises?
questions.zhStem: 哪个 Azure 资源为虚拟机提供隔离的专用网络，使其能互相通信、访问互联网和本地网络？
questions.definition: Azure Virtual Network provides the fundamental building block for your private network in Azure. This service enables Azure resources like virtual machines (VMs) to securely communicate with each other, the internet, and on-premises networks.
questions.zh: Azure 虚拟网络为你在 Azure 中的专用网络提供基本构建块。此服务使虚拟机（VM）等 Azure 资源能够安全地相互通信、与 Internet 通信以及与本地网络通信。

questions.stem: In a virtual network, what dedicated address range must an application gateway be deployed into?
questions.zhStem: 在虚拟网络中，应用程序网关必须部署到哪个专用地址范围中？
questions.definition: An application gateway is a dedicated deployment in your virtual network. Within your virtual network, a dedicated subnet is required for the application gateway.
questions.zh: 应用程序网关是一个专用部署，位于你的虚拟网络中。在你的虚拟网络中，应用程序网关需要一个专用子网。

questions.stem: Which Azure service routes HTTP requests to different VM pools based on the URL path?
questions.zhStem: 哪个 Azure 服务根据 URL 路径把 HTTP 请求路由到不同的虚拟机池？
questions.definition: Azure Application Gateway is a web traffic load balancer that helps you manage traffic to your web applications. ... Application Gateway makes intelligent routing decisions based on HTTP request attributes like URL paths and host headers.
questions.zh: Azure 应用程序网关是一种 Web 流量负载均衡器，可帮助你管理流向 Web 应用程序的流量。……应用程序网关会做出智能路由决策，依据是 HTTP 请求属性，例如 URL 路径和主机标头。

questions.stem: What are the smaller address ranges inside an Azure virtual network that resources are deployed into called?
questions.zhStem: Azure 虚拟网络中供资源部署的更小地址范围叫什么？
questions.definition: Azure virtual network subnets are essential containers where all Azure resources are deployed within a virtual network.
questions.zh: Azure 虚拟网络子网是必不可少的容器，虚拟网络中的所有 Azure 资源都部署在其中。

questions.stem: What filters inbound traffic so database VMs accept port 1433 only from business-tier VMs?
questions.zhStem: 用什么来过滤入站流量，使数据库虚拟机只接受来自业务层虚拟机的 1433 端口流量？
questions.definition: You can use an Azure network security group to filter network traffic between Azure resources in Azure virtual networks. A network security group contains security rules that allow or deny inbound network traffic to, or outbound network traffic from, several types of Azure resources.
questions.zh: 你可以使用 Azure 网络安全组来筛选 Azure 虚拟网络中 Azure 资源之间的网络流量。网络安全组包含安全规则，这些规则允许或拒绝流向多种类型 Azure 资源的入站网络流量，或来自这些资源的出站网络流量。

questions.stem: Which Azure service spreads internet TCP traffic across backend VMs at layer 4, without reading URLs?
questions.zhStem: 哪个 Azure 服务在第 4 层把来自互联网的 TCP 流量分配到后端虚拟机，而不读取 URL？
questions.definition: Azure Load Balancer is a cloud service that distributes incoming network traffic across backend virtual machines (VMs) or virtual machine scale sets (VMSS). ... Azure Load Balancer operates at layer 4 of the Open Systems Interconnection (OSI) model.
questions.zh: Azure 负载均衡器是一种云服务，可将传入的网络流量分配到后端虚拟机（VM）或虚拟机规模集（VMSS）。……Azure 负载均衡器在开放式系统互连（OSI）模型的第 4 层运行。

questions.stem: What spreads traffic across business-tier VMs inside a virtual network without exposing them to the internet?
questions.zhStem: 什么能在虚拟网络内部把流量分配到业务层 VM 上，且不暴露到互联网？
questions.definition: Alternatively, an internal (or private) load balancer is used to load balance traffic inside a virtual network.
questions.zh: 或者，内部（或专用）负载均衡器用于对虚拟网络内部的流量进行负载均衡。
keys: 内部（或专用）负载均衡器

questions.stem: To keep data in Canada, what do you pick, such as Canada Central, to deploy resources in?
questions.zhStem: 为了把数据留在加拿大，你要选择什么（例如 Canada Central）来部署资源？
questions.definition: Each region is a set of physical facilities that include datacenters and networking infrastructure.
questions.zh: 每个区域都是一组物理设施，其中包括数据中心和网络基础结构。

questions.stem: What are separate groups of datacenters within one Azure region, each with independent power, cooling and networking?
questions.zhStem: 一个 Azure 区域内彼此分隔、各自拥有独立电力、冷却和网络的数据中心组叫什么？
questions.definition: Many Azure regions provide availability zones, which are separated groups of datacenters within a region. Each availability zone has independent power, cooling, and networking infrastructure...
questions.zh: 许多 Azure 区域都提供可用区，即区域内彼此分隔的数据中心组。每个可用区都有独立的电源、冷却和网络基础结构……
keys: 彼此分隔的数据中心组
independent power, cooling, and networking infrastructure
独立的电源、冷却和网络基础结构

questions.stem: Which option protects VMs in one datacenter from a single server, rack or switch failure?
questions.zhStem: 哪个选项能保护同一数据中心内的 VM，免受单台服务器、机架或交换机故障影响？
questions.definition: VMs within the same availability set are deployed across multiple physical servers, compute racks, storage units, and network switches for redundancy.
questions.zh: 同一可用性集中的虚拟机部署在多个物理服务器、计算机架、存储单元和网络交换机上，以实现冗余。
